hooks#core.hooksPath: elm-cem is now a package inside the elm-cem-workspace monorepo, not its own git repository. A single git repository has exactly one core.hooksPath, so wiring it to this package's own hooks/ directory would break hook enforcement for every other package sharing the repo — per-package hook wiring is not possible in a monorepo. The workspace-level pre-push hook now exists at the repo root (hooks/pre-push, installed via `pnpm run hooks:install` -> tools/hooks-install.mjs) and runs the full workspace gate (tools/gate-all.mjs) on every push, including this package's own check/test — see docs/reviews/2026-08-17-thermonuclear-workspace-review.md findings 1.2-1.4 and their fix. This rule stays waived because it is structurally unsatisfiable inside a monorepo (core.hooksPath can never point at THIS package's own hooks/ dir specifically), not because enforcement is missing.
